seoTitle: Eisenhower Matrix Planner: Urgent and Important Sorter
metaDescription: Sort tasks into do now, schedule, delegate and drop from urgent and important flags you type. No dragging needed.
intro: Sorts tasks into the four Eisenhower quadrants from flags you type.
why:
The Eisenhower matrix separates what is urgent from what is important. Important work that is not urgent is where planning and growth happen, and it is the first to be skipped.

Type a task and flags u and i after a bar. Typing works with a keyboard and a screen reader, which dragging does not. If most tasks land in do now, your urgency flags may be too generous.
howTo: Add | u i, | i or | u after tasks.

faq.q: What if a task has no flags?
faq.a: It goes to drop or limit.
Yes, urgent and important work as well as u and i.
